open_points.subject: assemble_mapped_lists
open_points.text: - assemble_mapped_lists: [VALIDATION_ERROR] MUST measure every value list against the imported RELEASE_CEILING_STORED_VALUE_BYTES_MAX constant before it answers anything, and when the canonical bytes of any exceed it, or canonical_bytes refuses the list with NonCanonicalValueError — which for a list of stored canonical values happens only when it nests deeper than the release depth ceiling —, answer ListsOverCeiling naming the node and the first such port in the order given, with no list; it is given only the lists an edge takes to a node or a flow output, so every delivered list of a node is measured before any of them is written or delivered.
open_points.question: Must canonical_bytes accept a list, or must assemble_mapped_lists pass a str rather than the list?
